summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Quick Start (2025 Updated Version) p02: View Control ## Introduction Hello everyone, welcome to the quick tutorial series of Marvelous Designer 2025. In this tutorial, we will introduce you to the view control method in Marvelous Designer. ## Accessing View Control First of all, you can go to the main menu, select **Settings**, then **User Customization**, and find the **View Control** menu. From here, you can select the preview of the operation method according to your needs. In the **User Preview Download** menu, select your usual operation method. You can choose based on the usual 3D software type or mouse type. ## Adjusting View Settings In the view control column, you can also adjust and set specific operation methods separately. For example, in normal situations, when the mouse wheel rolls backward, it pulls towards the camera. However, if we move in the direction of the camera and roll the mouse wheel backward, it still pulls towards the camera. You can save these settings as user customizations for later use. You can open the saved settings file in the user customizations, or you can directly reset the user customizations to restore the original settings. In this series of tutorials, we use the default settings. ## Basic Navigation Controls Under default settings, press and hold the middle mouse button and drag the mouse to navigate. This operation method is the same for both the 3D and 2D windows. When you move the mouse wheel, you can release the view. At the same time, press and hold the left mouse button and drag the mouse to release the view. ### Rotating the View The rotation view can only be performed in the 3D window. To rotate the view, press and hold the right mouse button and drag the mouse. If you click on a specific object, it will automatically focus on that point, allowing you to rotate the view around the focused position. To cancel the focus mode, click on the 3D background again. You can also click and drag the right mouse button in the 3D window to adjust your view. ## View Options in the 3D Window There are additional view options available in the 3D window. You can find and select the correct and wrong views here, each of which has corresponding small keyboard shortcut keys. For example, the correct view shortcut key is **2**. Press the number key **2** to return to the front view. ## Adjusting Focal Length In addition, you can change the focal length, which allows the 3D window to be adjusted so that you can see all visible objects. This function is very useful for locating hidden objects. ### Using Zoom Functions The 2D window also supports the zoom in and out view function to help you find objects outside the field of view. After selecting the field of view, you can press the shortcut key **F** to focus on the selected field of view. In the 3D window, you can similarly focus on the selected field of view. The zoom in and out view can also be performed by focusing on specific objects. ## Conclusion This concludes the tutorial on view control. See you in the next video! ```
